templates.prompt_hint: Retain useful real-photo background context, create a large portrait cutout with a cream sticker outline, and place 3-5 large title chunks around the person contour. Use cream or mint-white title text with deep green or charcoal stroke. No colored title blocks.

Create a high-energy collage background with several image-like tiles, a sticker-cut portrait in front, a thick outlined headline, and a diagonal bottom banner. Rebuild clean original collage tiles; do not use watermarked reference images.
Use a warm kraft-paper background, white grid-paper area, tape strips, small labels, and a large cutout portrait. Keep labels small and the main title in a strong banner or upper-third composition.
Use a natural green or outdoor-blur background, oversized title text in the upper half, and simple white hand-drawn doodles. Keep the title huge and readable in the feed.

Use a sunlit outdoor/photo background, portrait on one side, elegant oversized title chunks, and minimal white arcs or line accents. Keep the palette leaf green, warm sunlight, pale yellow, and white.
